sources.title: Buccaneers WR Jalen McMillan is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with knee injury
sources.description: Quarterback Baker Mayfield's dislocated thumb was the headline news for the Buccaneers on the injury front in Week 3, but he isn't the only offensive player set to miss time.
